author: The Current
description:
Minnesota artist Dessa describes her new favorite hobby, cake decorating
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Receiving the gift of a carrot cake was the springboard for Dessa's new favorite hobby: cake decorating. Hear more about it in Dessa's interview with The Current's Mac Wilson.

Dessa's 2025 double-sided single "Camelot" / "Tough Call" is available on @DoomtreeRecords.

description:
During an interview with The Current, host Jessica Paxton asks how many songs Tweedy has written in his life.

Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

In September 2025, Wilco frontman Jeff Tweedy released his solo triple album, "Twilight Override." During an interview with The Current, host Jessica Paxton asks how many songs Tweedy has written in his life.

Jeff Tweedy’s 2025 album, "Twilight Override," is available on dBpm Records.

Jeff Tweedy – vocals and guitar
Sammy Tweedy – vocals and keyboards / synths

Sima Cunningham – bass and vocals
